word.name: entity.name.tag.word.ps
word.comment: Maximal run of 'patrick' tokens. Per-arity semantic coloring is applied by the extension's semantic-tokens provider; this scope is the TextMate fallback when semantic tokens are unavailable.

gap.name: punctuation.whitespace.gap.ps
gap.comment: Maximal run of single-space tokens. gap_width minus 1 is the instruction's immediate argument.

illegal.name: invalid.illegal.ps
illegal.comment: Any byte sequence not consistent with the two-token alphabet. The semantic-tokens / diagnostic surface gives the precise parse error; this is the coarse first-pass red-squiggle.
